title: Ninety Years of Hanging
subtitle: 钟铃与声响 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 钟铃与声响（生活与学习·器物与声音）
meta: 主题语境：钟铃与声响（生活与学习·器物与声音）　|　核心词汇：bell　|　正文 323 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 bell 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1946 my grandmother was given ① a bell that had hung in a school for ninety years, and she said the hanging was the whole of the gift. The ② bell, meaning the object and not the sound, was cracked in 1951 and rang for eleven more years; a bell, she said, is the only thing that is improved by being damaged.

Every ③ bell in that house had a different job, and the ④ bell by the door, meaning the one for the tradesmen and not either of those, was the only one anybody was allowed to ignore. A bell, my mother said, is nine parts duty and one part a wire that still works; my grandmother said the duty is the part nobody agrees about.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ bell was the whole of the hour, meaning the ringing and not the object. The ⑥ bell, meaning the sound and not any of that, is the only thing in a day that everybody obeys and nobody listens to; a bell, he said, is either something you hang or the only word that means both an object and an hour. She said the hour came first.

By 1962 the ⑦ bell had become a photograph in a book, and the book had become an argument about how old it was. The ⑧ bell of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in April, was ninety years of hanging and eleven of ringing; a bell, she said, is either the thing by the door or the reason you know the time. He said the time was never the point.

The ⑨ bell I remember is the one by the door, which was cracked and was never replaced. A ⑩ bell, my mother said in 1965, is the only object that improves by being ignored; every bell, she said, is an hour that has agreed to look like a thing. She said the hour was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 钟（指那个物件，与声音相对）
C. 固定搭配：be given a bell 得到一只钟／铃
D. n. 钟铃（指屋里每一只）
E. n. 钟铃（指门边那只）
F. n. 钟声；铃声（指那一小时／报时）
G. n. 铃声（抽象：那种声音）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a bell that had hung in a school for ninety years
The bell, meaning the object and not the sound
bell was the whole of the hour
the bell had become a photograph in a book
The bell of the whole thing
A bell, my mother said in 1965

answers.why: be given a bell 意为“得到一只钟／铃”，1946 年有人给了祖母一只在一所学校挂了九十年的铃。
bell 意为“铃”，指那个物件而不是声音，它 1951 年裂了，却又响了十一年。
bell 指屋里每一只铃，那屋里每一只都有不同的活儿。
bell 指门边那只（给送货人用的那只），是唯一允许被无视的。
bell 意为“钟声、铃声”，指那一小时的报时，父亲说 bell 就是那个钟点的全部。
bell 为抽象用法，指那种声音，是一天里人人都服从、却没人真正去听的东西。
bell 意为“铃”，到 1962 年这个 bell 成了书里的一张照片。
bell 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，祖母四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九十年的悬挂和十一年的鸣响。
bell 意为“铃”，我记得的是门边那只，它裂了，却从没被换掉。
bell 为抽象总称，母亲说铃是唯一会因为被无视而变好的物件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用

items: 1946 年有人给了祖母一只在一所学校挂了九十年的铃，她说挂过才是这份礼物的全部。（be given a bell）
那只铃，指的是那个物件而不是声音，1951 年裂了，却又响了十一年。（bell）
那屋里每一只铃都有不同的活儿。（bell）
门边那只铃，指的是给送货人用的那只，是唯一允许被无视的。（bell）
父亲说 bell 就是那个钟点的全部，指的是钟声而不是那个物件。（bell）
1965 年母亲说，铃是唯一会因为被无视而变好的物件。（bell）

The bell, meaning the object and not the sound, was cracked in 1951 and rang for eleven more years.
Every bell in that house had a different job.
The bell by the door, meaning the one for the tradesmen and not either of those, was the only one anybody was allowed to ignore.
My father said bell was the whole of the hour, meaning the ringing and not the object.
A bell, my mother said in 1965, is the only object that improves by being ignored.
